label: Figure 4
source_caption: Two attention heads, also in layer 5 of 6, apparently involved in anaphora resolution. Top: Full attentions for head 5. Bottom: Isolated attentions from just the word ‘its’ for attention heads 5 and 6. Note that the attentions are very sharp for this word.
caption: Look at the bottom panel: from the word *its*, the two heads put nearly all their weight on *Law* (its antecedent) and *application* (the noun it modifies), which the paper calls apparent anaphora resolution. Sharp, interpretable weights like these are what the authors mean by heads learning different tasks, though this is one sentence, not a measurement.
